1, +1)\n        if lp is not None: Ls.append(lp)\n        if rp is not None: Rs.append(rp)\n    p['L'] = min(Ls) if Ls else p['c0'] - 2\n    p['R'] = max(Rs) if Rs else p['c1'] + 1\n    top, bot = min(p['rows']), max(p['rows'])\n    # extend through blank interior rows (pipes at L and R, spaces between)\n    def interior(row):\n        if row < 0 or row >= H: return False\n        seg = grid[row][p['L']:p['R'] + 1]\n        inner = seg[1:-1]\n        return (seg[0] == '|' or seg[-1] == '|') and inner.strip(' ') == ''\n    while interior(top - 1): top -= 1\n    while interior(bot + 1): bot += 1\n    p['top'] = top; p['bot'] = bot\n    p['cx'] = (p['L'] + p['R']) // 2\n\n# ---------- tracing ----------\ndef cells(r, c, win=2):\n    out = []\n    for cc in range(max(0, c - 6):p['L'] - 1]\n        right_ext = grid[r][p['R'] + 2:p['R'] + 8]\n        if any(ch in BUSCH for ch in left_ext) or any(ch in BUSCH for ch in right_ext):\n            # extends beyond box: it's a bus adjacent to box\n            return (r, p['cx'])\n        r += direction\n    c = p['cx']\n    blanks = 0\n    for _ in range(25):\n        if r < 0 or r >= H:\n            return None\n        cs = cells(r, c)\n        wire = next(((cc, ch) for cc, ch in cs if ch in WIRE), None)\n        plus = next(((cc, ch) for cc, ch in cs if ch == '+'), None)\n        dash = next(((cc, ch) for cc, ch in cs if ch in '-~'), None)\n        letter = next(((cc, ch) for cc, ch in cs if ch.isalpha()), None)\n        if wire:\n            c = wire[0]; r += direction; blanks = 0\n        elif plus:\n            return (r, plus[0])\n        elif dash:\n            return (r, dash[0])\n        elif letter:\n            print(f\"TRACE hit letter: {p['name']} dir={direction} at row {r+1} col {letter[0]}\")\n            return None\n        else:\n            blanks += 1\n            if blanks > 2:\n                return None\n            r += direction\n    return None\n\nfor p in persons:\n    p['up'] = trace(p, -1)\n    p['down'] = trace(p, +1)\n\n# ---------- bus matching ----------\ndef segments(row, gap):\n    segs = []\n    start = None; last = None\n    for c in range(W):\n        if grid[row][c] in BUSCH:\n            if start is None:\n                start = c\n            elif c - last > gap:\n                segs.append((start, last)); start = c\n            last = c\n    if start is not None:\n        segs.append((start, last))\n    return segs\n\nGAP = 12\nbus_rows = defaultdict(lambda: {'parents': [], 'children': []})\nfor idx, p in enumerate(persons):\n    if p['down']:\n        bus_rows[p['down'][0]]['parents'].append((p['down'][1], idx))\n    if p['up']:\n        bus_rows[p['up'][0]]['children'].append((p['up'][1], idx))\n\nparent_of = {}\nfor row, d in sorted(bus_rows.items()):\n    segs = segments(row, GAP)\n    def seg_of(col):\n        for k, (a, b) in enumerate(segs):\n            if a - 1, +1)\n        if lp is not None: Ls.append(lp)\n        if rp is not None: Rs.append(rp)\n    p['L'] = min(Ls) if Ls else p['c0'] - 2\n    p['R'] = max(Rs) if Rs else p['c1'] + 1\n    top, bot = min(p['rows']), max(p['rows'])\n    def interior(row):\n        if row < 0 or row >= H: return False\n        seg = grid[row][p['L']:p['R'] + 1]\n        inner = seg[1:-1]\n        return (seg[0] == '|' or seg[-1] == '|') and inner.strip(' ') == ''\n    while interior(top -
